Innovation for Defence Excellence and Security (IDEaS)

IDEaS is a defence innovation program. This preamble describes the program in general terms, including trust, assurance, and verification, but it sits under the page heading rather than a section heading, so it is program prose, not a challenge card.

Current opportunities

Browse the components below.

Component 1a: operator trust and provenance studies

Component 1a offers up to $250,000 for early-stage work on operator trust, provenance, and lineage for autonomous systems, TRL 1-3. Closing date 2027-03-31. Details

Component 1b: provenance for sensor fusion

Component 1b offers up to $1,500,000 for provenance and lineage tooling for sensor fusion, with explainable outputs an operator can audit before acting. Closing date 2027-06-30. Details

Program history

IDEaS launched in 2018 and has funded hundreds of projects across Canada. Trust between industry and defence partners sits at the centre of the program's history and its community events.
